## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm packs:check` and `pnpm build` pass.
- [ ] New visible text exists in English and French, with no hard-coded string.
- [ ] Commands, engine changes and new rules have tests.
- [ ] Screenshots added to `docs/screens/` for a new or changed screen.
- [ ] Nothing reaches the real network: targets stay fictional, no real payload or exploit.
- [ ] Accessibility kept: real buttons, visible focus, 44 px targets, reduced motion respected.
